Killibuck’s Village

Killibuck’s Village was one of the Lenape settlements along the White River near present-day Chesterfield, Indiana.

Names & relationships

Ball State University’s White River research places Killibuck’s Village at present-day Chesterfield and lists it separately from Anderson’s Town.

Selected reading

01

The White River settlements

Ball State’s research identifies Killibuck’s Village in the Chesterfield area. Its library map uses the label Buck’s Town for the settlement in this part of the White River valley.
